taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-13 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AKH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-13
Curve type: AKH-type
Aquifer depth: 1.08 – 3.72 m (weathered/fractured zone represented by Layers 2–3, resistivities 2148.3–5322.7 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement within the 1.08–3.72 m interval, as this weathered/fractured zone is the most probable water-bearing horizon; drilling below 4.05 m is unlikely to be productive given the sharp rise to >18,000 ohm-m, indicative of compact, unweathered bedrock.
